summary:
Lane engine fails round 1 on one regression. 14 of the 15 package items pass on re-measurement; combat:F4 is partly. Every item is minor and there are no blocker or major items in the packages. The regression comes from combat:F4 (8b417c56). The new VFX lift cap dims the ultimate impact's own effects on the ground, and the lane's value_probe flash gate now fails on RIFT Low: 1.94x against >= 2.0x, 1.92x with the cap, 1.99x with the cap off. The engineer's own sweep at the commit showed 2.00x with the cap off and 1.93x with it, so the commit moved the gate from passing to failing. The same cap lowers Tunlan's ult core ratio in probe_combat_polish from 2.16 to 2.06 (gate 2.3, which it already missed). The F4 victim-box gate itself does pass: Kemdo 0.023, Rishal 0.202, Tunlan 0.219, Hesmi 0.281, all <= 0.35. Rishal reads 0.58 with the cap off, so the cap is what fixes him. Two things the item names are still visible in the beat shots: Tunlan's caster is a white bloom, and Hesmi's victim body is 0.829 white in the full frame. probe_combat_polish ult still exits 1 on core ratio (Tunlan 2.06, Hesmi 2.23). The F4 claim leaves out that exit 1.

Items that reproduce: engine-11 box cull (low-road fight landmarks 8,902 -> 0 main tris, 6,297 -> 0 shadow, frame 163,019 -> 142,578, blob 0 at all 14 spots); engine-12 per-clip swing (PASS, 3 attack1 + 3 attack2); engine-05/06 walkableSpread (RIFT High 42, Low 37 PASS); engine-09 bases (every base structure L* p95 <= 80 on RIFT and BRIDGE, both tiers); combat:F6-probe (32/32 measured, 0 retries, min sig 0.535); PERF-m3 (e2e rift journey, 0 console warnings, after the engine render commits); engine-04 notices (full license text of all 12 packages verbatim in dist/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, 3 @license comments kept); engine-01/03 content build (0 non-copy warnings, 17 routed copy warnings, new hits are errors).

items.evidence:
Gate met. `node _harness/probe_combat_polish.mjs ult --tag integ_engine_v1` (_harness/_reports/integ_engine_v1_combat_ult.log, fw_W1_combat_polish_integ_engine_v1.json): victim-box white Kemdo 0.023, Rishal 0.202, Tunlan 0.219, Hesmi 0.281, all <= 0.35. A/B with `--vfxcap off --ults tunlan,hesmi,rishal` (integ_engine_v1_combat_ult_capoff.log): Rishal 0.58, so the vfxLift cap is the fix.

Not met:
(1) The probe exits 1 both with and without the cap: 'FAIL tunlan: core x2.06 < 2.3', 'FAIL hesmi: core x2.23 < 2.3'. With the cap off they are 2.16 / 2.27, so the cap takes 0.10 off Tunlan's T4 core ratio. The claim leaves out this exit 1.
(2) value_probe RIFT Low flash is 1.94x FAIL (>= 2.0x): 1.92x with the cap and 1.99x with it off. The engineer's own integ_engine_f4_flash_caps.log has off 2.00x and 1.3 1.93x. Listed under regressions.
(3) The symptom the item names is still visible in the beat shots. In fw_W1_polish_ult_tunlan_beat_integ_engine_v1.png, Tunlan (the caster) is still a white bloom, and the box gate does not cover the caster. In fw_W1_polish_ult_hesmi_beat_integ_engine_final/v1.png, Hesmi's victim is a white silhouette: full-frame body white 0.829, unchanged by the cap. Over a body, vfxLift returns 1.0, so Hesmi's ult VFX are not touched. The W1 fixHint named 'Hesmi's ult hit'. Shaders: src/render/vfx/shaders.ts:69-90.
items.fixHint: Keep the body gate and stop taxing the ground effects that make the T4 punch. (a) In src/render/vfx/shaders.ts vfxLift, replace the plain division by ((1+lift)/(1+cap))^2.2 with a soft-clip: compress only the part of an effect's colour that would pass the envelope's display knee (about 0.86, the same as post.ts capB) after the lift. Dim and saturated light then keeps the full lift and only near-white goes down. Alternatively, exempt the ult impact's own layers (lib_ult_* and the kit's T4 impact) with a per-def flag. (b) In content/vfx.json, take down the luminance of Tunlan's ult cast bloom over his own body, and of Hesmi's ult hit layer over the victim. Target: victim body full-frame white <= 0.35. Done when probe_combat_polish ult exits 0 (box <= 0.35 per beat AND core >= 2.3 for all 4) and value_probe RIFT Low flash >= 2.0x. If the bot-chosen flash spot drifting onto brighter stone (base 85 -> 93.1, at (78.9,12.4)) is what puts RIFT Low at 1.99x even with the cap off, pin the flash spot per map the same way engine-05 handled 'fight'.
